column1: # assets/callability_genes.tsv: the genes where short reads are often not placed with confidence, so a
# 'no finding' there needs a reading of its own. Step 16b measures each gene on chr1-22, X and Y; the
# report lists the ones it could not read. Written by scripts/ci/build-callability.sh, which says how the
# rows and the owners are chosen; rebuild it there, do not edit it by hand. start is 0-based and end
# 1-based, as in a BED file; an ALT-only gene has its ALT scaffold as chrom and '.' as start and end.
# Genes: 1572 (CMRG 273, segdup 1276, false_duplication 22, collapsed 50, ALT-only 19); with an owner: 61.
